**Results**

| Gene | UniProt | Length | Mass (kDa) |
|------|---------|--------|-----------|
| NETO1 | Q8TDF5 (NETO1_HUMAN) | 533 aa | 60.191 |
| POLL | Q9UGP5 (DPOLL_HUMAN) | 575 aa | 63.482 |

UniProt-annotated molecular weights and BioPython-computed average masses agree to within 1 Da, so the comparison is robust: **POLL (DNA polymerase lambda) is heavier** by ~3.3 kDa.

Notes on the caveat: NETO1 is annotated as a precursor with a 22-residue signal peptide (mature chain 23–533), so the mature secreted/membrane form would be ~57.9 kDa — still lighter than POLL. POLL's entry is the full-length 575-aa protein with no signal peptide. Neither mass accounts for post-translational modifications (NETO1 is N-glycosylated at N306/N340, which would add mass in vivo).

<solution>POLL is the heavier protein. The two values differ by ~3.3 kDa, and UniProt's annotated masses match independent sequence-based calculations to within 1 Da.
